title: Space bound for the unary catalog machine
statement: For all natural numbers $d,C,t$ and every Boolean word $x$, the total number of work-tape cells visited by the unary catalog machine with parameters $d,C$, started on $x$ and run for $t$ steps, is at most $5(d+1)(|x|+1)$.
